title: synth.tube_bell~
description: `synth.tube_bell~` is an STK tubular-bell (orchestral chime) instrument that generates sound by summing two simple FM pairs. It can be played with `note` messages or NOTE/VEL lists, where velocity ranges from 0 to 127, and provides controls for pitch or frequency, gate, modulation, LFO, ADSR targets, and output crossfade.
